metadata.title: Roasted Tomatoes in Tangy Sugar Syrup | Manipuri recipe
metadata.description:
Khamen Asinba Athumba Thonga is a traditional Manipuri sweet and tangy dessert made with small sized ripe tomatoes.

This is a simple and easy relish that is traditionally served towards the end of a meal just before a sweet or dessert is being served.
